title: Bounded Exec
description: Run one shell command under a no-progress bound or an absolute ceiling, with process-tree cleanup.

cwd.description: Working directory. Relative paths are resolved from the workspace root.

env.description: Environment variables made available to the command.

timeoutMs.description: Absolute wall-clock ceiling in milliseconds, for a command that reports no tests. A backstop against an unbounded run, not a performance budget. A test target names idleTimeoutMs instead.

idleTimeoutMs.description: Kill the process tree when no test has finished for this many milliseconds: a runner's finished-test, file or package report, including Vitest reporter results, or a bun dot. Output that reports no finished test (a SLOW warning, a heartbeat) is not progress. A command that reports no tests makes progress only by exiting. Omit for no progress bound.

killAfterMs.description: Most milliseconds a timed-out or CPU-grant-revoked command gets after graceful termination before its process group is force-killed. The grace ends early when the command exits; whatever it leaves in its process group is force-killed then.

fixtureCommand.description: A compiler-fixture producer for command: a shell command run first, in the same cwd, environment and CPU grant, as a lifecycle build interval the progress bound does not run during. Its failure fails the run and command starts only after it exits 0. For warmth outside Nx outputs (a compiler plugin cache, a Cargo target directory): inside the consumer's task a cache hit restores the verdict and warms nothing, an execution warms first. Requires fixtureTimeoutMs.

fixtureTimeoutMs.description: The fixture segment's own wall-clock ceiling in milliseconds: a build budget bounding only the fixture interval, never the command it prepares. Required with fixtureCommand.

parallelism.description: Requested threads or processes before inherited runner ceilings: positive NEXTEST_TEST_THREADS and CARGO_BUILD_JOBS cap their respective runners, and configured counts may only lower an inherited ceiling. Omit to let the command decide (nextest and cargo one per core, `bun test --parallel=N` N, anything else one). Runner concurrency is min(bounded request, tokens its parent CPU pool grants); the actual held grant reaches the command as BOUNDED_EXEC_CPU_TOKENS, with its sub-pool in BOUNDED_EXEC_CPU_POOL.

forwardAllArgs.description: Append unparsed Nx CLI arguments to the command.

args.description: Extra arguments appended to the command.
